finding_history.finding: V1 referred shoppers to a chart whose combined-unit labels and single values were known to be ambiguous, without disclosing that specific issue at the example.
finding_history.communication: Finding sent directly to root before further source propagation; no initial supplement review file was published.
finding_history.resolution: This chart's unit labels need clarification. Contact us to confirm the units and whether the figures are body or garment measurements before choosing a size.
finding_history.localized_callout_updates_and_independen: Separate required work; not certified by this English review.

direct_link_decision.decision: Retain both exact direct links as conditional sleeve-style comparisons with V2 disclosure and existing intended-fit/no-compliance-proof warnings.
direct_link_decision.premise: Article does not transfer PDP cotton-gauze, relaxed bedtime, care, all-size or stock assertions into verified advice; it requires unresolved details to be clarified before ordering.
direct_link_decision.counterconsideration: Linking the named products could otherwise look like endorsement of their unresolved chart or child sleepwear claims. V2 addresses the known chart issue in place; the retained safety paragraph expressly denies that a pajamas listing proves compliance.
direct_link_decision.limits: Neither product is certified suitable for child sleepwear, cotton composition, safe fit, current stock or all-market delivery. The underlying PDP issues remain separate and unresolved.
